node.title: Re^2: Howto convert Image::Grab jpg object to Image::Magick object???
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
Do I need to use Blobs??

Did you try the code I posted? As far as I can tell from the docs, this should be all you need to get the $imgdata I showed in [id://1186053|my other post]:

use Image::Grab qw/grab/; my $imgdata = grab('http://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/1/1a/Image_upload_test.jpg'); # - or - my $pic = Image::Grab->new; $pic->url('http://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/1/1a/Image_upload_test.jpg') $pic->grab; my $imgdata = $pic->image;

(untested)
